evidence.title: GTA-RAG: Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning

summary: A new study presents GTA-RAG, a graph-trajectory-augmented reinforcement learning approach to enhance multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning in AI systems. The method aims to improve contextual understanding and decision-making in complex, iterative tasks.
title: Researchers Introduce GTA-RAG: A New Framework for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
